1  O R D E R Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the respondent- State of Haryana.
We have been told that the petitioner is already in custody in a different criminal case and has been granted interim bail in that case.

Presently, with regard to the present petition, he seeks anticipatory bail in a case in which he has been named as an accused for the offences punishable under Sections 406 & 420 of the Indian Penal Code (for short the IPC) and subsequently Sections 467, 468 & 470 of the IPC were added.
His anticipatory bail application was dismissed by the High Court.
We see absolutely no reason to interfere in the order of the High Court, in exercise of our jurisdiction under Article 136 of the Constitution of India.
The present petition is, accordingly, dismissed along with pending application(s), if any.
